evals.name: basic-html-no-existing-ids
evals.prompt: Run add_html_ids.py on evals/case_001/input.html with --prefix case001_
evals.expected_output: Every HTML element without an id gets a unique new id with prefix 'case001_', no duplicates, original content unchanged except id insertions

evals.name: tsx-mixed-ids
evals.prompt: Run add_tsx_ids.py on evals/case_002/input.tsx with --prefix case002_
evals.expected_output: Existing IDs 'case002_h1', 'heroCopy', 'scrollSection', and 'case002_div' preserved exactly; missing lowercase JSX elements get prefixed IDs; React 'ProductCard' component skipped

evals.name: html-with-script-style
evals.prompt: Run add_html_ids.py on evals/case_003/input.html with --prefix case003_
evals.expected_output: IDs added outside script/style, no STR markers leaked, JavaScript < operators untouched, 'world's' apostrophe preserved, original content unchanged except id insertions

evals.name: html-preserve-existing-id-hooks
evals.prompt: Run add_html_ids.py on evals/case_004/input.html with --prefix case004_
evals.expected_output: Existing IDs used by CSS, anchors, and JavaScript remain exactly unchanged; missing elements get prefixed IDs; original content is unchanged except id insertions
